review_candidates.title: Immunization Supply Chain Manager
review_candidates.description: About Villagereach VillageReach transforms health care delivery to reach everyone. We are driven by a vision of a world where each person has the health care needed to thrive. VillageReach's goal is to reduce inequities in access to quality primary health care for 350 million people by 2030. We work with governments, the private sector, partners and communities to build responsive primary health care systems that deliver health products, information and services to the most under-reached. As a locally driven and globally connected organization, VillageReach has offices in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique and the United States. Description Summary The Manager, Immunization Supply Chain, coordinates and manages implementation of VillageReach's work in Nigeria to improve immunization outreach through context-appropriate cold chain solutions, with a focus on mobile cold chain equipment (CCE) and temperature-controlled powered vaccine storage (TPVS) options, including Indigo devices. As part of VillageReach's Nigeria country team, the Manager reports to the Nigeria Country Lead and receives technical direction from the Project Lead. The role coordinates assessments of cold chain options, development and testing of outreach planning approaches, and translation of findings into practical decision-support resources. Based in Abuja, the Manager works closely with government counterparts, state-based project personnel, VillageReach technical teams, and partners collaborating on cold chain assessment, outreach planning, and implementation. The Manager also coordinates with project teams and partners in other participating countries to align methods, tools, and learning within a unified approach that can be adapted to country contexts. Implementation in Nigeria will take place in either Kaduna or Katsina State, as agreed with government and partners. The role contributes to reliable, efficient, and equitable immunization services for under-reached communities. Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time. Key Responsibilities Government Liaison and Partner Coordination Coordinate national government and project partner engagement, joint planning, and follow-up; align approaches and share learning with teams in other participating countries Work with state-based project personnel to align implementation with national discussions, document decisions, and escalate country coordination issues to the Nigeria Country Lead and technical issues to the Project Lead Project Management and Implementation Oversight Manage the in-country workplan, timelines, and deliverables; provide day-to-day coordination and review of work undertaken by state-based project personnel Coordinate field activities, technical inputs, and logistics; manage procurement of Indigo devices with relevant VillageReach colleagues, working with UNICEF or the manufacturer to confirm requirements, delivery timelines, and deployment readiness. Monitor expenditure and delivery risks and recommend adjustments Cold Chain Assessment and Outreach Planning Coordinate operational assessments and workshops to compare mobile CCE and TPVS options, define outreach archetypes, and test planning approaches using existing geographic and operational data Oversee limited field testing or structured documentation, equipment deployment readiness, and training support, assessing performance, usability, costs, and feasibility Evidence Generation and Reporting Coordinate monitoring, data collection, quality checks, and analysis with technical colleagues, accounting for operational constraints, community preferences, and gender-related workforce implications Synthesize findings and prepare progress reports, evidence summaries, and presentations for government, partners, and project reporting Decision-Support Resources and Knowledge Translation Translate findings into practical planning guidance, decision trees, comparison matrices, and readiness checklists that fit existing government processes Coordinate user validation, partner feedback, and refinement of deliverables for the Project Lead's technical review, aligning resources with the shared approach across participating countries Competencies: VillageReach has ten (10) Organizational Competencies that describe how we work together and get things done that are grouped into three strategic areas of Achieving Great Results, Setting Direction and, Bringing Others With you. For a full description, please download our Organizational Competency document. Achieving Great Results : Risk Taking and Innovation Key Behaviors: Comfort with ambiguity, curiosity, adaptability, unconstrained and undeterred creativity, resourcefulness Business Judgement Key Behaviors: Getting to root causes, understanding environment, navigating complexity and ambiguity, entrepreneurial energy Building Strong Teams Key Behaviors: Trust in Subject Matter Experts (SME's); radical candor to resolve conflict, hold each other accountable as colleagues, focused on results, commitment to mission Setting Direction: Compelling Communication Key Behaviors: Clear and evidence-based communication, audience adaptability, curious listener Resilient Self Leadership Key Behaviors: Self-aware, plan how one shows up, emotionally intelligent, use one's own agency and takes accountability Stewardship and Personal Alignment Key Behaviors: Take ownership, display ethical conduct, effective at resource management, alignment of personal objectives with organizational goals and mission, focus on continuous improvement and sustainability Bringing Others with You: Influencing Leadership Key Behaviors: Cultivate trust, influences to make change, navigate the matrix structure Radical Partnership Key Behaviors: Share information and credit, address conflict, increase impact through collaboration, political and contextual awareness Cultivates a Growth Mindset Key Behaviors: Seek out diverse input, demonstrate flexibility in thinking and curiosity, embrace challenges, demonstrate persistence, seek learning opportunities Cultural Intelligence and Inclusion Key Behaviors: Continuous learning and ally-ship across cultural lines, challenge prejudice and bias, modeled in one's own behavior Requirements To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Supervisory Responsibilities: Provides day-to-day project coordination, technical guidance, and review of work undertaken by state-based project personnel. Education & Experience: Education Bachelor's degree required Graduate degree (or equivalent experience) in public health, health systems, supply chain management, international development, or a related field required Experience At least five years of relevant experience in immunization, health systems, vaccine supply chains, or public health program implementation, including management of complex activities and partner relationships Strong experience in vaccine supply chain management is required, including coordination of equipment procurement or deployment. Familiarity with CCE procurement processes and experience working with UNICEF or manufacturers are desirable Demonstrated experience working with Nigeria's National Primary Health Care Development Agency (NPHCDA), State Primary Health Care Development Agencies (SPHCDAs), and Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI) teams, coordinating across national and state levels Experience in immunization outreach, microplanning, or vaccine logistics, with an understanding of how cold chain capabilities influence service delivery. Understanding of mobile CCE and TPVS is preferred but not required Experience coordinating operational assessments, quantitative and qualitative data collection, analysis, and evidence-informed program decisions Experience facilitating technical workshops and developing practical guidance, tools, or implementation resources Experience managing workplans, overseeing field personnel or consultants, and contributing to donor-funded program reporting Experience with GIS-informed planning, operational costing, or introduction of new cold chain technologies is desirable Other Qualifications: Strong coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities and stakeholders and maintain reliable follow-through Ability to assess operational tradeoffs and translate technical findings into clear recommendations for government and frontline users Strong analytical and documentation skills, including proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint and comfort working with routine program data Ability to interpret maps and geographic information for planning; proficiency in specialized GIS software is an asset Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Hausa proficiency is an asset Sound judgment, adaptability, and the ability to work independently while seeking technical support when needed Demonstrated cultural sensitivity and ability to work respectfully with government officials, health workers, communities, and multidisciplinary partners Commitment to equitable access and gender-responsive programming, including attention to workforce participation and community preferences Willingness and ability to be based in Abuja and travel regularly within Nigeria, including to participating LGAs, facilities, and communities, in accordance with organizational security procedures Environment and Physical Demands: VillageReach employees typically work in a shared, open environment with task and conference rooms accessible to employees for privacy and meetings. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Due to the time zone differences across our USA, Kenya and Country Offices and location of other global staff, we have established core collaboration hours between 6am Pacific Time and 18:00 South Africa Time (GMT+1) Monday through Thursday. All staff, regardless of location are expected to be available between these hours. During Daylight Savings Time, this allows for 12 hours per week (3 hours/day) of collaboration time and during Standard Time, 8 hours (2 hours/day). We do not hold cross-office meetings on Friday. Approximately 90% of the day will spent sitting on non-travel days. On travel days or during field visits, up to 75% of the day may be spent standing. COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION: VillageReach is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. We believe that diverse, equitably weighted perspectives foster an organizational capacity to create novel solutions that improve health in the most under-reached and hard-to-reach areas. To align our values, innovations and impact, VillageReach is committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse global workforce. APPLICATION INFORMATION: This is an immediate hire and therefore resumes will be reviewed on a rolling basis until 30th October 2026. To apply, please submit your resume, a cover letter, plus short answer responses to our online portal: http://www.villagereach.org/join-us/. In your cover letter, please address (1) Why you are interested in this position, (2) What is one reason you think you'd be a good fit for this position and, (3) what is one strength you would bring to this position? Hiring Process: The hiring process will include the following steps: Review submitted applications Conduct 20-30 minute screening interviews for shortlisted candidates Conduct skills and value-based interviews for 3-5 candidates Request that top candidates submit a practical assessment (designed to take no more than two hours to complete). Sometimes the assignment will occur before the interview Conduct final interview if necessary Request references Make offer Conduct background check Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted, but candidates who proceed to step 2 will be notified if they are not chosen for step 3. Safeguarding: VillageReach is committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults, and beneficiaries with whom it engages. We expect everyone working with us to share this commitment through our code of conduct.All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which may include criminal records. VillageReach participates in the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme and, in line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants' previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse, and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By applying, the job applicant confirms his/her understanding of these recruitment procedures. Benefits Compensation & Benefits: VillageReach has an established compensation structure that is based on the relevant market and internally transparent. The range for this position is entry point $55,300 to midpoint $73,700 annually. We hire people into the established range based on one's experience and education and considering internal equity. We do not inquire about salary history. Please refer to our compensation overview on our website for more information and for more information on employee benefits.

review_candidates.title: IT Application Project Lead
review_candidates.description: IT Application Project Lead 📍 Location: Cairo, Egypt 💼 Employment Type: Full-time 👤 Number of Positions: 1 🌍 Job Type: External Lead IT Projects That Power Egypt’s High-Speed Railway Be part of a landmark project that is transforming transportation in Egypt. DB-El Sewedy Rail Operation Egypt (DBEE) is looking for an IT Application Project Lead to join its team in Cairo and take a key role in delivering IT applications and solutions across Egypt’s high-speed railway organization. This is an exciting opportunity for an IT project professional who enjoys ownership, stakeholder management, technology delivery, and working in a fast-paced infrastructure environment . You will play a central role in taking applications from planning and testing through to successful go-live, while working closely with business teams, IT specialists, vendors, and project stakeholders. The Role Reporting to the Manager IT Projects and Applications , you will take ownership of IT project delivery from planning through implementation and go-live. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with the required quality , while keeping stakeholders aligned and ensuring that systems are stable, documented, tested, and ready for successful adoption. As the organization grows, the experience and relationships you build through project delivery will provide an excellent foundation for developing your expertise in enterprise application management and long-term IT ownership . Your Responsibilities Plan and manage IT projects end-to-end , including scope definition, scheduling, risk identification, delivery planning, and stakeholder coordination. Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into clear delivery plans , defined acceptance criteria, and traceable project outcomes. Support structured change and release management , ensuring system changes are properly planned, controlled, and introduced with minimal business disruption. Coordinate release and go-live activities , including deployment planning, cutover preparation, implementation coordination, and post-release follow-up. Support functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by coordinating test execution, tracking defects, and ensuring users are prepared for go-live. Maintain the integrity of development, test, and production environments, proactively identifying risks related to system configuration and data quality . Work closely with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors to keep projects on track and address delays or quality concerns at an early stage. Maintain accurate and structured project documentation , including project plans, risk and issue logs, decision records, action trackers, and status reports throughout the delivery lifecycle. What You Bring Educational background in IT, Computer Science, or a related field is welcome; demonstrated ability to successfully manage and deliver IT projects is equally important. 3–5 years of experience in IT project delivery, project coordination, or change and release management. Ability to independently manage project plans, risks, actions, and stakeholder communications . Familiarity with ITIL change management principles and structured release processes. Experience working with enterprise applications and coordinating deliveries involving multiple vendors and internal teams. Strong organizational and documentation skills, with a structured and methodical approach to project delivery . Excellent communication skills and the ability to keep diverse stakeholders aligned throughout the project lifecycle . PMP, PRINCE2, or ITIL 4 Foundation certifications are an advantage. Arabic is required , with strong professional English communication skills. Comfortable working on-site and during occasional off-hours cutovers when required. Why Join DBEE? Be part of Egypt’s first high-speed rail project . Gain hands-on experience in a high-profile, large-scale infrastructure environment . Work across IT, business, applications, vendors, and project teams , giving you broad exposure to enterprise technology delivery. Take real ownership of projects from planning through go-live . Develop your expertise in enterprise applications, ITIL processes, change management, and project delivery . Build experience within an organization combining international railway expertise with local excellence . Create a strong foundation for future opportunities in IT Project Management and Application Management . Ready to Make an Impact? If you are an organized and proactive IT professional who enjoys turning requirements into successful technology deliveries, this could be your opportunity to contribute to a project that will shape the future of mobility in Egypt. Join DBEE and help bring the future of high-speed rail to life. DB-El Sewedy Rail Operation Egypt is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. We value diversity, inclusion, and a respectful, collaborative, and high-performing work environment.

cela inclut la préparation et la négociation des bons de commande, la présentation aux partenaires, la supervision des missions, l’examen et la validation des livrables, etc. Proposer activement de nouvelles activités au directeur technique et au chef d’équipe;
